headline: ibyyue enters ARC-2 gold as Nguyen falls out

sections.text: ibyyue gained 4.59 points to reach 41.81, moving from 18th to 14th and into the 15 gold places.
Nguyen dropped from 14th to 16th at 39.58, just outside the medal line; the 15th-place cutoff rose to 40.83.
